items.headline: Rising oil prices, falling technology stocks and reversing bond yields shake Wall Street
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.6% and the Nasdaq Composite fell 1.4% as Brent crude rose 4.3% to $104.49. Treasury yields reversed after a strong 30-year bond auction, while higher yields and oil prices added pressure to technology stocks and broader risk assets.

items.headline: Jim Cramer sees more AI upside ahead for Meta, Microsoft and AMD despite bubble fears
items.summary: Cramer said investors seeking AI exposure could consider established technology companies with multiple potential beneficiaries from AI adoption, specifically citing Meta and Microsoft and also discussing AMD, while acknowledging stretched valuations and dot-com-bubble comparisons.
